bio.text: Geral "Bishop" Staten is an independent candidate for Virginia's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Suffolk, Virginia, earned a high school diploma from Nansemond River High School, and has worked as a civil servant.

sources.title: Luria and Kiggans rematch in Virginia's 2nd Congressional District among most watched races in nation
